reader_work_moment: A planner, buyer, KAM, or supply-chain manager receives a changed supplier date and needs to decide whether it has become a customer-facing exception.
spatial_thesis: One incoming date-change ticket is first assessed against the customer need-by, current promise and allocation context it could affect; it then tests credible supplier exposure and recovery. The current customer date remains held until a credible miss remains after recovery and reaches one joint-exception gate.

claim_support.public_wording_boundary: Call this a proposed operating check. Do not claim it predicts delivery, reduces cost, has been deployed, or is a universal standard.

reference_mechanisms.mechanism: a visible condition changes the next move rather than leaving the reader with a list of checks
reference_mechanisms.anti_copy_boundary: No source palette, title treatment, selection-tree geometry, wording, or animation choreography is used.

reference_mechanisms.mechanism: small decision units remain attached to one coherent information object and reward a deep read
reference_mechanisms.anti_copy_boundary: No source matrix, row/column composition, language, or surface styling is used.

motion.sentence: A semantic-state animation may later reveal how one failed test diverts the customer commitment; no motion is selected until the static visual proves useful.
